card.name: The word shown pointing to a table
card.fires_on: The word "shown" (or "below", "described") right after "as" or "is/are" in a dosing sentence that points the reader to a table, as in "modified as shown in Table 3".

modes.label: as shown in Table
modes.description: "shown" after "as" or "are" that refers to a numbered table of dose changes.
modes.example: reduce HYRNUO dosage as<< shown>> in Table 3.

modes.label: shown below
modes.description: "shown" or "below" after "is" that points to the dosage given next.
modes.example: The dosage in pediatric patients ≥ 6 months of age is described<< below>> in Table 2.
